messages:
maria: incident-bot attempted to page the infra on-call at 15:02 UTC but Slack shows a bot post with no thread or reactions — no one actually received the page.
incident-bot: paging attempt failed: upstream pagerproxy 504 Gateway Timeout; payload_id=abcd1234; attempt=1
sre-oncall: I didn't get any phone or SMS. I see a faint bot message in #incidents with no thread. No ack options displayed.
jamal: checking pagerproxy logs — saw a 504 at 15:02:08 then a 200 on retry at 15:02:11, but our incident-bot timed out at 500ms and marked it failed.
ops: do we have any customer-facing impact? any open escalations?
maria: support reports three delayed alerts for customers on Dedicated capacity (tickets #8765 #8766). Customers noticed delayed incident pages.
emily: switching to manual ringdown and SMS fallback now. I'll post manual updates to customers.
jamal: enabled manual fallback: `./scripts/pager/manual_page --team infra --note "fallback due to pagerproxy timeout"` — confirming calls out.
oncall-helper: I've toggled automation console: disabled quiet window and enabled manual SMS fallback :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: automation paused by human at 15:05 UTC — remember to re-enable once stable.
jamal: immediate mitigation plan: 1) increase incident-bot RPC timeout from 500ms -> 1500ms, 2) add 3x local retry with 100-300ms jitter, 3) enable temporary manual fallback for 1 hour. Will deploy hotfix.
maria: can we confirm change doesn't impact latency SLOs? we need to avoid long blocking during busy spikes.
jamal: change is scoped to the paging call only; non-blocking path will return early if retries fail. rolling deploy now to canary.
incident-bot: deploy hook: canary rollout started to infra service group.
ops: team, please monitor oncall acknowledgements and support tickets for the next 60m. I'll open a follow-up incident to track customer comms.
emily: I'll draft the customer note and post to #customer-updates after 30m if all clear.
maria: postmortem notes: probable root cause — pagerproxy transient slowness + too-aggressive incident-bot deadline. Action items: increase deadline, add retry + jitter, add metric for 'ghost posts' where bot posts without actionable ack, and test with simulated 500-700ms responses. Assign to jamal and sre-oncall.
jamal: assigning PR and issue: GH #2045; will have follow-up changelog and rollback plan.
ops: thanks all — manual fallback active, monitoring in progress. :white_check_mark:
